RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Ringblade rush
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Rush to a valid cell within 8 cells, then spin for 22 base physical damage against up to 16 enemies within 3.2 cells. Damage bonuses and armor apply.

RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Blink
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Teleport to a visible, unoccupied cell within 8 cells. Granted only by the relevant augment cards.

RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Pursuit mark
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Mark a visible enemy, jump to a valid adjacent cell within 10 cells, then strike for 32 base physical damage.

RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Return
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Within 3.25 seconds of moving, manually return to the previous valid origin within 12 cells. Cannot cross maps or opaque obstacles.
